scores.rationale: Two boxes of used, untested brand-name power tools (Makita, Bosch, Hitachi) would realistically total about $100-150.
Mixed modern and worn generic hand tools with no maker stamps, rusty; under $30.
Yamaha NS-5X is a modest 1980s bookshelf speaker; pair with stands realistically $60-100.
KEF Q80 pair with Uni-Q is a known brand, but cosmetic damage and possibly no grilles; about $100-180.
Unbranded 2.5kVA inverter generator, untested; $60-150 depending on running order.
One-piece root bench is a decorative piece but badly weathered and split; about $100-200.
Cast iron theatre seat frames with rotten upholstery need full restoration; modest decorator demand, $50-100.
Ducar 7500W open-frame generator is worth $250-400 if it runs; running condition unknown so discounted.
Pair of repainted Victorian-style cast garden chairs, likely cast aluminium; about $80-200.
Older Sartorius lab balances, one with damaged mount; niche market, about $40-80 for the pair.
